I’m a master’s student in Biostatistics on the Data Science track at Columbia University. I earned my B.A. in Applied Mathematics from New York University.

I’m interested in causal inference, especially how study design and statistical assumptions shape what we can learn about treatment effects. I use R and Python for data cleaning, visualization, and analysis.

See my [resume](resume.html) for my education.
